_docs.outDir: Where the static mirror is written (relative to this folder).
_docs.assetBaseUrl: URL prefix under which same-origin assets are served by WordPress. Default matches wp-content/uploads/framer-mirror.
_docs.selfHostUserContent: If true, also download images/fonts from framerusercontent.com and rewrite them locally (fully self-contained, but heavier). If false, those stream from Framer's CDN. Framer's runtime JS (framerstatic.com) is always kept absolute because it constructs chunk URLs at runtime.
_docs.maxPages: Safety cap on number of pages crawled.
_docs.waitMs: Extra settle time per page after network idle (for animations/lazy content).
extraRoutes: Optional list of absolute URLs to force-capture if the sitemap misses them.
